historical_context.time_period: Post-Fall Kalsa during the adopted Shortened Watch Failure; absolute date, era name, and mutual order with other adopted histories remain unresolved.
historical_context.location: The fixture-bounded last clearance house at the main outflow channel of the event's unnamed reservoir and polity.
historical_context.summary: An ordinary channel-maintenance closure becomes irreversible when observable release signs appear while the approved schedule still promises work time. Isca Rel can warn, protest, rescue, and preserve evidence, but cannot directly stop the upstream operator or undo the already accepted formula.

public_facts.text: Kalsan settlements maintain old works that may still carry water, pressure, heat, movement, or signals through later masonry and institutions.
A surviving formula can operate an inherited system without proving who lawfully owns its public consequence.

ambient_pressures.text: The same inherited watch word named different practical durations in the source record, conversion, managers' schedule, and notice delivered to workers.
Machine acceptance records that a submitted formula was accepted; it does not validate the conversion, schedule, public notice, or distribution of risk.
Before the later settlement, downstream workers lacked the explicit stop authority created in response to the disaster.
Warnings, rescue capacity, tools, evidence custody, and exit space compete for the same people and narrow physical routes.

groups.label: Last clearance house and channel crew
institutional_logic: Clear the outflow channel, keep a usable downstream warning, and return workers and tools before release.
material_incentives: Retain a record later reviewers can compare
internal_virtues: A line prepared before it is needed
Naming which record made which promise
internal_shames: Leaving a worker below for a cleaner board
Saving evidence by pretending it saved bodies
prestige_markers: A counted crew on the landing
Tools returned above the wet line
taboo_triggers: Blaming worker speech before checking the schedule
Calling machine acceptance a complete safety finding
emotional_display_norms: Fear enters clipped orders, rope work, counting, and jokes made while there is still enough time to laugh.
trust_defaults: Trusts observable process, prepared routes, named ownership, and coworkers' bodies more than a shared heading or distant approval.

groups.label: Gatehouse operator, conversion clerk, and managers
institutional_logic: Translate the inherited interval into an approved work schedule and submit the accepted release sequence.
material_incentives: Defend the competence of the conversion chain
internal_shames: A downstream warning outrunning official instruction
An accepted formula producing an unlawful schedule
taboo_triggers: A vernacular worker overturning a signed conversion
A local process sign treated as stronger than certified text
emotional_display_norms: Alarm is compressed into defense of record scope, signature, and approval.
trust_defaults: Trusts the signed bridge and gatehouse acceptance; may treat downstream divergence as pace, speech, or discipline failure.

groups.label: Workers, residents, and yards below the clearance house
institutional_logic: Act on delivered warning and preserve lives and ordinary work outside the formal technical chain.
internal_virtues: A warning carried farther than rank
internal_shames: Waiting for the official pattern after local danger is visible
Crowding the only crew exit in search of shelter
prestige_markers: People accounted for beyond the work board
A copied warning that matches what was heard
taboo_triggers: Being reduced to an empty schedule cell
A notice nobody received being cited as public consent
emotional_display_norms: Urgency appears as abandoned carts, lifted children, answering bells, and disputes over which stair is still open.
trust_defaults: Trusts warnings that are audible and actionable; cannot inspect the upstream formula while water approaches.
speech_register_cues: Who has moved and who has not

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A machine acceptance is tempting because it makes several human judgments look like one objective result.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Let Dema defend the signed conversion through the accepted value while the scene keeps the schedule and notice visibly separate.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Observable water behavior can require action before the authority chain admits its schedule is wrong.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make early warning, crew withdrawal, evidence custody, and equipment loss compete without giving Isca retroactive formal stop authority.

target_self_read: People located where the formula becomes water
The hands responsible for physical clearance
misread_patterns: Mistakes one shared word for one shared duration
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Dema's defense plausible inside the prestige chain without making downstream evidence merely emotional.

observer_read: Paper trying to overrule wet stone
target_self_read: A traceable technical chain protecting a dangerous public work from improvisation
misread_patterns: May collapse Dema's bounded conversion duty into sole ownership of the failure
May treat all distant technical caution as class contempt
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let workplace anger sharpen accountability without inventing one villain or one forged ledger.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A downstream keeper who owns local warning, muster, and record custody but cannot directly cancel the upstream formula.
failure_modes: Warning people into a blocked stair
Saving records while rescue hands fail
Losing credibility before the signal must carry

role_pressure_fields.summary: The worker responsible for bodies, braces, and movement at the physical workface.
obligations: Refuse a board contradicted by water
failure_modes: Assuming warning leaves the stair clear
Treating a local sign as a complete technical account

role_pressure_fields.summary: The accountable keeper of the signed conversion whose value entered the approved schedule.
obligations: Keep machine response separate from the human schedule
failure_modes: Letting rank harden uncertainty into schedule

role_pressure_fields.summary: A young channel worker whose position makes the abstract interval a bodily hazard.
obligations: Carry line or records when ordered
failure_modes: Trusting the work board over the wall

known_context.text: Isca knows the local signs, record table, warning meanings, crew positions, stair state, and which notices she delivered.

beliefs.text: Isca believes an accepted formula cannot make an occupied channel empty or a missed notice delivered.

misreads.text: Isca may underweight how a lower warning draws residents into the crew's only covered exit.

must_not_know.text: Isca must not know the operator's private reasoning, exact formula grammar, or total downstream casualties while the scene is unfolding.

known_context.text: Dema knows the source copy used, the signed conversion, its intended task, and that the gatehouse accepted the submitted value.

beliefs.text: Dema initially believes the traceable accepted value is stronger evidence than an unauthorized downstream warning.

misreads.text: Dema may hear worker vernacular and gallows humor as imprecision rather than evidence of a different lived schedule.

must_not_know.text: Dema must not treat acceptance as proof that notice, conversion, and schedule expressed the same duration.

known_context.text: Anet knows crew positions, brace state, line capacity, stair access, and the process signs visible at the workface.

beliefs.text: Anet believes wet stone and moving grit are enough to pull workers even when they are not enough to reconstruct the source interval.

misreads.text: Anet may collapse all technical responsibility into Dema because the signed conversion is the nearest visible administrative object.

must_not_know.text: Anet must not know the remote gatehouse state except through its visible signals and the release itself.

author_only_boundaries.text: The clearance-house geometry, signals, names, and process signs are one fixture-marked elaboration inside the adopted event, not a universal Kalsan public-works template.
The scene precedes the settlement's explicit downstream stop authority. No branch may use later reform as an already available command power.
Every ending preserves the adopted injuries, damaged equipment and channel works, and water reaching places the schedule treated as empty; local variation remains inside unresolved totals.

open_questions.question: What polity, reservoir, downstream district, and present archive own the event?
open_questions.notes: The fixture leaves all four unresolved and uses only the event-bounded clearance house.

open_questions.question: What exact inherited interval, local watch duration, notation, and conversion method failed?
open_questions.notes: The fixture dramatizes record divergence without supplying any number, pronunciation, or formula grammar.

open_questions.question: How many people were injured, what damage remained, and what compensation was paid?
open_questions.notes: Endings preserve injury and material damage while refusing a total or final remedy.
